data.name: No Escape
data.description: ;You can move up to double your base speed as an immediate action. You can use this ability only when an adjacent foe uses a withdraw action to move away from you. You must end your movement adjacent to the enemy that used the withdraw action. Youprovokes attacks of opportunity as normal during this movement.
